chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 505: Zhuge Yuan – A Deadly Resurrection & Dream Trap
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang’s quest to resurrect Zhuge Yuan backfires when the Dice traps him in a dream contract. A choice between saving a friend and trusting a monster.
og_title: A Fragile Victory Shattered: Li Huowang’s Resurrection Gambit Goes Wrong
og_description: Can Li Huowang even trust his own mind? He makes progress, only to fall into a layered dream trap set by the Zuowandao.
twitter_title: The horror of false hope: Li Huowang’s resurrection of Zhuge Yuan turns into a dream contract with the Dice.
twitter_description: Li Huowang achieves the impossible, but his reality crumbles again when a dice-headed monster forces a deal in a layered dream.

lore_anchors.definition: A core Daoist internal alchemy term for the pre-differentiated, fundamental energy of the universe from which all things are born. It is the "original spark" of life.
A high Daoist deity, the Mother of the Big Dipper, associated with life and fate. In this novel, she is a Siming whose domain governs the boundary between truth and falsehood.
A powerful artifact stolen from the Supervisory Heavenly Office; it enables Doumu to see into the nature of truth and falsehood within a subject, acting as an ontological audit.
